plain_statement: Data. Fano plane, lines {0,1,2}, {0,3,4}, {0,5,6}, {1,3,5}, {1,4,6}, {2,3,6}, {2,4,5}; inputs x0..x6 then y0..y6. The list of exactly 30 AND and OR gates written in the statement, each reading two earlier wires (so it reads only earlier wires), computes on all 2^14 inputs the function true iff some x_p and y_l with p on line l are both on; and for each gate, replacing either input by the constant true or by the constant false changes the function, with a witness input named in the statement for each case.
title: Data, Fano plane: an explicit 30-gate fan-in-two AND/OR circuit computes the incidence function and no gate input can be fixed to a constant
